name: community-ishir
summary: Ishir's ult: a shotgun blast when the mark on the enemy pops (a community member's clip, not in git), once (not also on the press)

assets.why: Ishir, Sever Spirit (R): the shotgun blast that plays when the mark pops. A new sound: a copy of the game's own CannonFire SoundWave (48 kHz stereo Ogg) with a community member's clip, 10 dB quieter than the clip (about 3 dB below the game's revolver shots).
Ishir, Sever Spirit (R): when the mark ends (it pops and deals its damage), every player hears the shotgun blast on the marked enemy, next to the mark's own end sound.

Ishir, Sever Spirit (R): the Ishir player heard the shotgun twice, once right on the press. His own game put a stand-in mark on the enemy at the press and dropped it when the server's arrived, and dropping it ran the mark's pop. Only the server puts the mark on now, as every other player already saw it.
